text_block_list.text: While pondering over <chrname>'s training menu on the academy rooftop――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Just when I thought I'd relax and read some cosmetics
magazines here, looks like somebody beat me to it~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait... you look kinda down.
If you don't mind me, I'm all ears?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I get it... You've been agonizing all on your own and ended up stuck in a rut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
At times like that...
Maybe taking off running isn't such a bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Doing something totally unrelated
or eating yummy food helps me refresh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's literally me right now, too!
I just really wanted to take a breather from studying for exams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In order to dust yourself off and face things again...
A positive tactical retreat is important, you know?
choice_data_list: Thank you. But I still want to give it my all.
All right, I'll try running away too!
All right, I'll try running away too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:

A positive tactical retreat is important, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's so cool!
You've got some incredible guts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, gotta watch out for overdoing it.
We need to make sure we fit in proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things get too rough, just let me know.
I'm always here if you need someone to talk to.

Afterward, through patient and careful deliberation...
I was able to put together a fully satisfying menu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh! Let's make a run for it together!
Even if we take the long way around, as long as we come back, it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's go grab something sweet at the cafeteria!
There's a dessert I've really been wanting to try~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
As a reward for working so hard,
this one's on meâª

Afterward, perhaps thanks to taking a positive breather,
I was able to put together a fully satisfying regimen.
